name: Caffeine Half-Life Calculator
description: Estimate how much caffeine may remain in the body over time using an adjustable caffeine half-life.
search_intent: Estimate caffeine remaining after a given number of hours and explore when caffeine levels may substantially decline.
keywords: how much caffeine is left in my system
calculation: Remaining caffeine = initial caffeine dose × 0.5^(hours elapsed ÷ half-life hours). Remaining percentage = remaining caffeine ÷ initial dose × 100 when the initial dose is positive. Eliminated caffeine = initial dose − remaining caffeine. Handle zero dose safely.
limitations: Actual caffeine metabolism varies substantially among individuals.
Pregnancy, medications, smoking, genetics, liver function and other factors can change caffeine half-life.
The result is a pharmacokinetic estimate, not a medical or sleep guarantee.
